Hi Elise — thanks for the clear ask and the questionnaire. High-level immediately: Redwood supports in-region processing for hosted and private deployments, and we have an EU-only operational profile we can propose for regulated customers. That said, there are a few items in your workbook that require ops/legal artifacts (SCCs exhibit, backup scope, backup deletion proof), so I'd like to pull those together with Marissa and Stephanie.

Quick answers to your bullet points: 
- Control plane telemetry: our hosted control plane is offered in an EU region for EU-only customers; however some telemetry for multi-tenant hosted customers may traverse non-EU regions unless the EU-only profile is enabled. For Private (VPC/on-prem) customers, control plane connectivity is customer-managed and can be restricted to EU-only.
- SCCs: we execute the European Commission's standard contractual clauses with customers; we also maintain a current subprocessor list and can provide the exporter contact for signature exhibits.
- Deletion evidence: we can provide an attestation letter and a sample deletion log (hash + timestamp) for primary stores. Backups are retained for a configurable period; we can provide a backup deletion certification but will need to confirm exact timelines for your proposed retention window.
- Backups in EU: yes for EU-only deployments. For hosted shared customers backup copies can be restricted to EU regions when the EU-only profile is in effect.

1) Marissa (security) to share the in-region dataflow diagram and sample deletion artifacts.

Elise — looping in more detailed technical artifacts as discussed. Please find below and attached the dataflow diagram for our EU-only profile and a short FAQ that maps your questionnaire to the artifacts we provide.

Attachment: redwood-eu-data-flow.png (PNG, 180KB)

Highlights / answers to a few of your questionnaire rows: 
- Architecture: For the EU-only profile we provision compute, storage, and backup slices in EU zones only. The control plane endpoints are hosted in the EU control region and are accessible over customer-managed networking for Private deployments. For Hosted EU-only customers, control-plane telemetry is retained in the EU and is not cross-border.
- SCCs / Exporter: We sign SCCs; Stephanie has prepared an SCCs exhibit template we can populate. We also provide a time-stamped subprocessor registry export for contract exhibits.
- Deletion evidence: We produce a deletion attestation that includes an object hash (SHA-256), deletion timestamp (UTC), and the storage shard identifier. For backups, we provide a backup manifest showing snapshot timestamps and an associated deletion event when snapshots are rotated or purged. Note: backup purges can have a short reconciliation window (up to 72 hours) depending on the retention policy; we indicate that window in the attestation.
- Logs and telemetry: Operational logs containing debugging-level traces are redacted for customer-identifying fields prior to any long-term export; audit logs tied to customer actions are exportable and can be scoped to EU-only storage.

Operational caveat: If a customer requires contractual assurances that absolutely no account data may ever transit non-EU infrastructure under any circumstance, we recommend either Private deployment (VPC or on-prem) or an EU-dedicated hosted tenancy with contractual controls. We can include a fallback contractual clause and a migration path in the SCCs exhibit.
